in_marathi.name: Satnam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truth is my essence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satnam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sat means truth and nam means essence or identity. Satnam means that truth is the core or essence of a person's being.

in_bengali.name: Satnam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Truth is my essence
in_bengali.long_meaning: Satnam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sat means truth and nam means essence or identity. Satnam means that truth is the core or essence of a person's being.
